cards.name: Spinner
cards.text: Operates cog-shaped mechanisms, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Tear of Light
cards.text: Dispels Twilight clouds from battle squares, removing the Twilight restriction and revealing enemy locations.

cards.name: Bomb
cards.text: Opens cave entrances in mountain walls and destroys boulders on land, unlocking a secret reward or revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Water Bomb
cards.text: Destroys boulders in bodies of water, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Clawshot
cards.text: Pulls Warrior to a marked target, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Jar
cards.text: Weighs down switches, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Lantern
cards.text: Lights torches, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Ooccoo
cards.text: Teleports from an activated (green) Warp Portal to its partner, opening the square on the other end. Portals are activated by completing the battle square.

cards.name: Digging Mitts
cards.text: Digs up green, X-marked plots of soil, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Fishing Rod
cards.text: Catches Fish in bodies of water, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Compass
cards.text: Reveals all secrets within a battle square, making their tiles sparkle.
